description: This source file defines the CellFill class within the PhpSpreadsheet's Xls writer style namespace. It manages the mapping between fill styles and corresponding integer codes, providing a method to get the style code based on a Fill object.

classes.name: CellFill
classes.description: A utility class for mapping Fill styles to integer style codes used in XLS writing.

methods.name: style
methods.description: Converts a Fill object into a corresponding integer style code based on its fill type.
